This script will generate a series of tables with ABC Atlas links using the kiwi "API" for inclusion in CHARGE.

## Setup

First let's load the libraries and create a landing point.
```{r setup}
setwd("/root/capsule/scratch/")
dir.create("links")
source("code/shiny/abc_atlas_gene_url_function.R")

library(httr2)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)

schema_path = "/root/capsule/code/shiny/abc_atlas_schema_kiwi.txt"
```

## Building starting URLs

In this section we will build our starting URLs, select starting genes, and read in the set of all possible 
genes for the relevant data set. This is a largely manual process and this section will include it. Note that
for each of the next few sections, the order of the rows matters and is the same.


Now set up complete gene lists

```{r gene lists}
# Functions for pulling complete gene lists
get_gene_symbols_ABC_Atlas <- function(url) {
  html <- httr2::request(url) %>%
    httr2::req_perform() %>%
    httr2::resp_body_string()

  stringr::str_match_all(
    html,
    "<td>\\s*<b>([^<]+)</b>\\s*</td>"
  )[[1]][,2]
}
get_gene_symbols_table <- function(url) {
  df <- read.csv(url, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  rownames(df)
} 

## Define the URLs
prefix    = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AllenInstitute/abc_atlas_access/refs/heads/main/docs/gene_lists/"
BG_fn     = paste0(prefix,"HMBA-10xMultiome-BG/human_gene_list.html")
SEAAD_fn  = paste0(prefix,"SEA-AD-Multiregion-10X/gene_list.html")
WMB_fn    = paste0(prefix,"WMB-10X/gene_list.html")
WHB_fn    = paste0(prefix,"WHB-10Xv3/gene_list.html")

M1_fn     = "https://idk-etl-prod-download-bucket.s3.amazonaws.com/aibs_human_m1_10x/medians.csv"
IsoHip_fn = "https://idk-etl-prod-download-bucket.s3.amazonaws.com/aibs_mouse_ctx-hpf_10x/medians.csv"

## Pull the gene sets

gene_sets <- list(
    BG = get_gene_symbols_ABC_Atlas(BG_fn),
    SEAAD = get_gene_symbols_ABC_Atlas(SEAAD_fn),
    WMB = get_gene_symbols_ABC_Atlas(WMB_fn),
    WHB = get_gene_symbols_ABC_Atlas(WHB_fn),
    M1 = get_gene_symbols_table(M1_fn),
    IsoHip = get_gene_symbols_table(IsoHip_fn)
)


# Which complete gene list to use for generating URLs
which_list = c(
    "WHB",
    "WMB",
    "WHB",
    "BG",
    "BG",
    "BG",
    "SEAAD",
    "SEAAD",
    "M1",
    "SEAAD",
    "IsoHip",
    "IsoHip",
    "WMB",
    "WHB",
    "WMB",
    "WHB"
)

```


```{r make URLs}

create_transcriptomics_explorer_url <- function(desired_genes, starting_url, ...){
    paste0(starting_url, desired_genes)
}

create_url <- function(desired_gene, starting_gene, starting_url, ...){
    if(!grepl("https://knowledge.",starting_url)) 
      return(create_transcriptomics_explorer_url(desired_genes=desired_gene, starting_gene=starting_gene, starting_url=starting_url, ...))
    return(create_abc_atlas_gene_urls_batch(desired_genes=desired_gene, starting_gene=starting_gene, starting_url=starting_url, ...))
}

# Now create a list of all the links for all the data sets
link_list <- list()
for (i in 1:length(name)){
    print(name[i])
    genes = gene_sets[[which_list[i]]]
    print(paste(length(genes),"genes in this data set."))
    urls <- create_url(genes,starting_genes[i],starting_urls[i],schema_path = "../code/shiny/abc_atlas_schema_kiwi.txt")
    link_list[[i]] <- data.frame(gene = genes,url  = urls)
}
names(link_list) <- name
```

Finally output the results to a series of csv files.

```{r output results}
for (nm in name)
  data.table::fwrite(link_list[[nm]], paste0("links/",nm,".csv.gz"))
save(link_list,file="link_list.RData")
```
